questions.question: Did the population of Town C increase by at least 100 percent from the year 2000 to the year 2010?

options.1: The population of Town C in 2000 was 2/3 of the population in 2005.
options.2: The population of Town C increased by a greater number of people from 2005 to 2010 than it did from 2000 to 2005.

questions.explanation: البيان الأول: عدد السكان في 2000 = 2/3 عدد 2005، أي الزيادة من 2000 إلى 2005 = 1/3 من عدد 2005. الثاني: الزيادة من 2005 إلى 2010 أكبر من الزيادة من 2000 إلى 2005، أي أكبر من 1/3. معاً، إجمالي الزيادة من 2000 إلى 2010 > 1/3 + 1/3 = 2/3 من عدد 2005. النسبة المئوية للزيادة = (الزيادة)/(عدد 2000) = (أكبر من 2/3)/(2/3) > 1 = 100%. الإجابة الصحيحة هي C.

questions.question: In a survey of 200 college graduates, 30% said they had received student loans during their college careers, and 40% said they had received scholarships. What percent of those surveyed said that they had received neither student loans nor scholarships during their college careers?

options.1: 25% of those surveyed said that they had received scholarships but no loans.
options.2: 50% of those surveyed who said that they had received loans also said that they had received scholarships.

questions.explanation: نفرض أن x = عدد من حصل على القروض والمنح معاً. البيان الأول: من حصل على منح فقط = 25% من 200 = 50، والمنح الكلي 40% أي 80، إذن x = 80-50=30. البيان الثاني: 50% من حاملي القروض (30% من 200 = 60) حصلوا على منح أيضاً، أي x = 0.5×60=30. في كلتا الحالتين، عدد من لم يحصل على شيء = 200 - (60+80-30) = 90، أي 45%. الإجابة الصحيحة هي D.

questions.question: Stores L and M each sell a certain product at a different regular price. If both stores discount their regular price of the product, is the discount price at Store M less than the discount price at Store L?

options.2: At Store L, the discount price is $5 less than the regular store price; at Store M, the discount price is $6 less than the regular price.

correct_answer.question: Let S be the set of all 7-digit numbers N such that the sum of the digits of N is divisible by 7. A and B are two 7-digit numbers: A = 4,893, P12 and B = 5,857,0Q5. Select a value for P so that A is an element of S. Select a value for Q so that B is an element of S.
correct_answer.explanation: A: مجموع الأرقام باستثناء P = 4+8+9+3+1+2 = 27. نريد 27+P يقبل القسمة على 7. 27+8=35 (يقبل القسمة على 7). P=8. B: مجموع الأرقام باستثناء Q = 5+8+5+7+0+5 = 30. نريد 30+Q يقبل القسمة على 7. 30+5=35. Q=5.
